newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks end up on short covering.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks end up on short covering.

text.p: Pakistani stocks finished slightly higher on Monday amid covering of short positions before a long weekend starting on Wednesday, dealers said.
"Most of the day's trading was marked by short-covering as the market will remain closed for four days from Wednesday onwards," dealer Salman Ahmad of Finex Securities said.

The Karachi Stock Exchange 100-share index rose 1.28 points, or 0.09 percent, to close at 1,370.78. Losers led gainers 189 to 78. Hub Power Co rose 0.25 to 31.95 rupees. PTCL fell 0.20 to 26.90. -- Ovais Subhani 9221-5685192
